title: Capitalization inconsistency between docs & type on `openaiChatResponseSchema`
body: ### Description The logProbs param here should be `logProbs` in the schema, not `logprobs` according to the docs: https://sdk.vercel.ai/providers/ai-sdk-providers/azure See `openaiChatResponseSchema`. ### Code example _No response_ ### AI provider "@ai-sdk/azure": "^1.1.0", ### Additional context _No response_

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.

Explanation: The issue references an LLM provider ("@ai-sdk/azure") and concerns schema parameters used in LLM responses ("logProbs" vs. "logprobs"), which falls under "Incompatible parameters to LLM providers" in the agent issue taxonomy. This directly affects agent-LMM integration.
